title: Gas Genie
description:
Gas fee was always an hassle for people to deal with, whether they be developers or web3 newbies. Resistance to purchase crypto for paying gas fee and sometimes needing to purchase crypto just to pay gas makes them to resort to traditional and centralized methods of payment. This problem can be solved by introducing an onchain user activity based rewarder, who can fund user gas fee in return for their participation on our platform. Participation can be as small as watching an ad, to as entertaining as attending webinars or games and to as challenging as solving github issues, all in return for a ERC-721 Gas token which represents an upper limit on potential gas fee sponsorship. Welcome, Gas-Genie 🧞, an easily resuable and customizable user gas sponsoring SDK and platform which can track gas tokens, serve as a partner collaboration platform and a gamified ecosystem, all to provide service as gas fee in return for engagement. Let's bring the barrier down!
